description: This file defines a custom exception class `PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException` used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when a pipeline function is not recognized, and includes mechanisms for serialization/deserialization, message building, and exception handling within the project.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an unknown pipeline function is encountered. It extends `DittoRuntimeException` and implements `PlaceholderException`. Provides methods for construction, JSON deserialization, and builder pattern.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for this exception, initialized with a specific function expression to include in the error message.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the exception from a JSON object and headers, reconstructing the exception instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder pre-filled with the current exception data (deprecated).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
